pages.text: Your class defines your combat role. It modifies your HP, your weapon effectiveness, and grants you passive abilities and one active skill. Classes are implemented via the $(bold)Origins$() system as a separate layer from your Race.$(br2)There are $(bold)10 classes$(). All are viable. The pack does not have a 'best' class — it has classes that match different playstyles.

$(bold)Respeccing Your Class$()$(br2)Classes can be changed at a $(bold)Class Altar$() — a craftable station requiring a tier-appropriate boss drop + 30 XP levels. You do not lose skill points when you respec your class. The altar can be shared between players on a server.$(br2)$(bold)Races are permanent.$() Your race is chosen at character creation and cannot be changed.

$(bold)Three Layers of Identity$()$(br2)$(bold)Race$() — What you ARE. Innate traits, mild tradeoffs. Permanent.$(br)$(bold)Class$() — What you DO. Combat role, HP modifier, weapon affinities, active ability. Respec-able.$(br)$(bold)Skills$() — How you INVEST. Cumulative bonuses across six trees. Respec costs 5 levels per point.$(br2)These three layers stack additively. A $(thing)Berserker$()/$(thing)Orc$() with Warfare tree investment is a very different character from a Berserker/$(thing)Elf$().$(br2)$(bold)Next: undecided? $(l:icraft:welcome/class_guide)Pick Your Origin, Race & Class$(/l) matches classes to playstyles.$()

$(bold)The 'Half Equipment HP' Rule$()$(br2)$(thing)Ranger$(), $(thing)Archmage$(), and $(thing)Void Summoner$() receive only 50% effectiveness from all equipment-sourced max HP bonuses. This includes Vitality enchant, HP affixes, and armor attribute modifiers.$(br2)$(italic)Does not affect$() base HP, Spice of Life food HP, or JustLevelingFork level-up HP. Glass cannon classes have a lower HP ceiling — but they're still rewarded for investing in food diversity and leveling.
